description: Delete the review or the statement the user wrote on a perfume, from the user's own Parfumo account. Cannot be undone: the text, its awards and its comments are lost. Deleting a text that does not exist is not an error. Returns whether Parfumo still holds the text after the call. Supports dry_run. Requires a linked Parfumo account.

oneOf.description: Statement: short review of 140 characters at most.

dry_run.description: When true, nothing is sent: the answer shows the request that would be made.

perfume.description: Perfume the review or statement is about: `id`, Parfumo URL or numeric `p_id`.

name: parfumo_delete_review_or_statement

ClassVotes.description: The member's votes in one classification group.

options.description: Every label Parfumo offers in this group.

MemberRatings.description: Ratings a member attached to a review or statement.

OwnDraft.description: The member's own review or statement on one perfume, as the edit form would load it.

text.description: Text; empty when the member wrote nothing on this perfume.

WriteCall.description:
A write request to Parfumo, as built before being sent (also shown by `dry_run`).
The session `csrf_key` is added at send time and never appears here.

form.description: Form fields (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`), without the CSRF token.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was sent to Parfumo.

executed.description: True when at least one write request was sent.

my_classification.description: The member's classification votes as Parfumo holds them after the call; before it in a dry run.

my_ratings.description: The member's ratings of the perfume (0-10) as Parfumo holds them after the call; before it in a dry run.

my_text.description: The member's review or statement as Parfumo holds it after the call; before it in a dry run.

notes.description: Side effects and things to know.

planned_requests.description: The write requests sent, or that would be sent (CSRF and form tokens omitted).

public_writes_enabled.description: Whether this server is allowed to send publicly visible writes (operator setting).
